tests: ✔ tar extraction keeps traversal/links inside the fixture and preserves strip/onentry API
✔ tar honors extraction depth and metadata size limits
✔ node-pre-gyp packaging callback and file extraction promise APIs remain usable
✔ neon reads an ordinary Cargo lib name with the selected TOML parser
✔ tmp rejects escaping prefix and symlink directory; external-editor still cleans up
✔ both Terminal3 UUID callers produce v4 and reject undersized v3/v5/v6 buffers
✔ http-client preserves Agent conversion with controlled local HTTP and abort
✔ Undici rejects control characters in blob content type before a request
✔ Undici rejects cookie domain attribute injection
✔ public Terminal3 payload/verifier: malformed, missing proof and expired rejected without a signer
security.oracleCorrection: TOML maximum depth produces a bounded Error with line/column, not SyntaxError; corrected predicate still rejects baseline RangeError. Earlier TMP/TOML probes were strengthened using actual advisory paths.
baselineFailures: ✖ tmp rejects escaping prefix and symlink directory; external-editor still cleans up
